loader.query:
select e.vacancy, max(e.dateIteraction) from hunttech_IteractionList e where not e.vacancy.vacansyName like 'Default' group by e.vacancy order by max(e.dateIteraction) desc
e.candidate = :candidate
select e from hunttech_OpenPosition e where e.openClose = false or e.openClose is null order by e.vacansyName

select e from hunttech_OpenPosition e where e.openClose = false or e.openClose is null order by e.vacansyName
e.positionType = :positionType
e.positionType in :positionTypes
select e from hunttech_Position e where e.positionRuName not like '%(не использовать)%' order by e.positionRuName
select e from hunttech_Company e order by e.comanyName
select e from hunttech_City e order by e.cityRuName

select e from hunttech_IteractionList e where e.comment is not null and e.comment not like '' order by e.dateIteraction desc
e.candidate = :candidate

suggestionField.query: select e.firstName from hunttech_JobCandidate e where lower(e.firstName) like lower(:searchString) escape '\'
select e from hunttech_JobCandidate e where lower(e.middleName) like lower(:searchString) escape '\'
select e from hunttech_JobCandidate e where lower(e.secondName) like lower(:searchString) escape '\'

suggestionPickerField.query: select e from hunttech_Company e where lower(e.comanyName) like lower(:searchString) escape '\' order by e.comanyName, e.companyShortName
